prompt: An isotope has a half-life of 8 days. What fraction of the original sample remains after 24 days? Give your answer as a decimal.
explanation: Twenty-four days is three half-lives, so the sample halves three times: 1 to 1/2 to 1/4 to 1/8, which is 0.125.
